title: Aria's Unlikely Triumph
source_story: I missed my train, spilled coffee on my shirt, ran to the interview anyway, and somehow got the job.

characters.name: Aria
characters.visual_description: Young woman, curly brown hair, denim jacket, expressive

panels.beat: Aria, wide-eyed, stares at a departing train, steam rising around her. Her hands are flung up in exasperation.
panels.caption: Monday morning. The train pulled away as I reached the platform.

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.text: No, no, NO! Not today, of all days!
